events.name: Sappholicious Burlesque show

Come hungry, come thirsty, come with your friends — but come curious, because the only way to know who's performing is to be in the room when the lights go down and Katana Rexia takes the mic.

DJ Dea holds down the transitions and keeps the crowd loose between sets — because even grunge nights need a groove. Expect combat boots next to cocktail glasses, sunset turning to string lights, and a patio crowd that's equal parts mosh-curious and margarita-in-hand.

This one's for the ones who still know every word to '90s alt-rock anthems and the ones who just want to feel something loud. Come let your inner grunge kid out — Azúcar's got the stage, the sound, and the drinks ready.

events.name: Les-Be-Emo Drag Show

Dig out your studded belt and your saddest playlist — the Patio is about to smell like Hot Topic and heartbreak. Les-Be-Emo Drag Show takes everything you loved (and cringed at) about 2000s-2010s emo and grunge and hands it straight to our queens, who are going to wear it, weep it, and wreck it in the best way possible.

Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff hosts the chaos, guiding you through a night of lip-syncs and looks pulled straight from your old MySpace profile — think smudged black eyeliner, band tees ripped just right, and choruses that hit like your first breakup. This is drag with a lump in its throat and a fist in the air.

Come for the nostalgia, stay because you suddenly, inexplicably, want to run away from home again. Grab a drink, grab a friend, and let the night talk you into (or out of) texting your ex — no judgment either way. Azúcar's Patio is the setting, angst is the mood, and everybody's invited to feel sixteen again.
